title: SonarQube instance inventory
$comment: This file lives in the engine repository, not writable by project teams: it carries the URLs queried by the authorization check.

groupes_interdits.$comment: Overly broad groups: an admin permission held by one of them does not count as authorization (refusal + alert).

url.$comment: https required: an admin token does not transit in the clear.

api_identite.$comment: Uncertainty point #2: access path to externalIdentity. See docs/a-verifier.md.

fournisseur_identite_sso.$comment: Identity provider name (the SSO IdP's 'provider' field) as known to THIS Sonar instance. Used to pick, among the external identities returned for an account, the one coming from the corporate directory rather than some other configured IdP.

variable_token.$comment: Exception to the derived convention. The pattern forbids designating a secret outside the reserved prefix.
